concepts.quote: 6.02e23 is 6.02 times e to the power 23.
concepts.why: Reads the e in the literal as Euler's number rather than as the exponent-of-ten marker; 6.02e23 means 6.02 x 10^23, so this is the listed L0 wrong rule.
The answer says nothing about double arithmetic, comparison, division by zero, or int vs double.
